blogs.title: The Comeback Kid: Why LSTMs Are Ready to Challenge Transformers Again
blogs.description: Explore the history of LSTMs, why they lost the race to Transformers, and how the new xLSTM architecture fixes their three biggest flaws—revision, storage capacity, and speed—to compete with modern Large Language Models.

blogs.title: Beyond Binary Gates: How 'Exponential Gating' Lets AI Change Its Mind
blogs.description: Dive deep into the concept of exponential gating in sLSTM. Learn how moving beyond standard sigmoid gates allows neural networks to dynamically revise past storage decisions, solving complex state-tracking problems that stumped previous recurrent models.

blogs.title: From Scalars to Matrices: Supercharging AI Memory with mLSTM
blogs.description: Understand the shift from scalar memory cells to massive matrix memories in mLSTM. This post explains how using covariance update rules dramatically increases storage capacity, enabling better recall of rare tokens and long-context associations without the quadratic cost of attention.

blogs.title: Speed Meets Efficiency: Can xLSTM Offer Linear Scaling for Edge Devices?
blogs.description: Analyze the performance benefits of xLSTM, focusing on its linear computation complexity and constant memory usage. Discover why this architecture is uniquely positioned for real-time applications and deployment on resource-constrained edge devices compared to heavy Transformer models.
